class.pinned_note: Derek's call: an immediate dynasty WR4 when he arrives (2026-10-06). Always the 1.01 in every mock, whoever holds the pick (2026-11-17).

build.name: Pick Hoarder
build.about: An outsized share of value sits in draft picks.
plan: Picks lose value as the draft nears unless they're early; know which ones to use and which to flip.
Turn late firsts into young players who already produce.
Package several picks to move up for a top-three pick in a strong class.
reasons: 12th of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (102.2)
53% of player value is 24 or younger (3rd most)

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
reasons: 1st of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (184.1)
29% of player value is 24 or younger (7th most)

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.
reasons: 2nd of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (163.6)
